nodes.label: Art. 3 — Obliged entities
nodes.description: Obliged entities

nodes.label: Obliged entity
nodes.description: Generic category for entities subject to AML obligations under the Regulation.

nodes.label: Credit institution
nodes.description: A credit institution as defined under EU law, subject to AML obligations.

nodes.label: Financial institution
nodes.description: A financial institution covered by the AML Regulation.

nodes.label: Auditor, external accountant and tax advisor
nodes.description: Auditors, external accountants and tax advisors providing tax advice as principal activity.

nodes.label: Estate agent
nodes.description: Estate agents and real estate professionals acting as intermediaries in transactions with rent ≥ EUR 10,000.

nodes.label: Person trading precious metals and stones
nodes.description: Persons whose regular professional activity involves trading precious metals and stones.

nodes.label: Person trading high-value goods
nodes.description: Persons whose regular professional activity involves trading high-value goods.

nodes.label: Provider of gambling services
nodes.description: Entities providing gambling services.

nodes.label: Crowdfunding service provider
nodes.description: Crowdfunding service providers and intermediaries.

nodes.label: Cultural goods trader
nodes.description: Persons trading or intermediating cultural goods where transaction value ≥ EUR 10,000.

nodes.label: EUR 10 000
nodes.description: Monetary threshold of ten thousand euros.

nodes.label: Art. 11 — Compliance functions
nodes.description: Compliance functions

nodes.label: Compliance manager
nodes.description: Person appointed to oversee compliance with the AMLR.

nodes.label: Compliance officer
nodes.description: Person responsible for day‑to‑day AML/CFT compliance and reporting.

nodes.label: Supervisor
nodes.description: National competent authority supervising the obliged entity.

nodes.label: FIU
nodes.description: Financial Intelligence Unit receiving suspicious transaction reports.

nodes.label: Appoint compliance manager
nodes.description: Obliged entity must appoint a compliance manager.

nodes.label: Appoint compliance officer
nodes.description: Obliged entity must appoint a compliance officer.

nodes.label: Provide resources to compliance functions
nodes.description: Obliged entity must allocate adequate staff and technology to compliance functions.

nodes.label: Protect compliance officer
nodes.description: Obliged entity must protect the compliance officer from retaliation and discrimination.

nodes.label: Allow compliance officer reporting
nodes.description: Compliance officer may report directly to the management body.

nodes.label: Report suspicious transactions to FIU
nodes.description: Compliance officer must report suspicious transactions to the FIU.

nodes.label: Report compliance manager to management body
nodes.description: Compliance manager must regularly report to the management body.

nodes.label: Suspicion of money laundering
nodes.description: Situation where a transaction is suspected of involving money laundering.

nodes.description: Application of customer due diligence measures

nodes.label: Exempt obliged entities from applying CDD measures
Art. 20 — Customer due diligence measures
nodes.description: Customer due diligence measures

nodes.label: Assess purpose and nature of business relationship
Art. 21 — Inability to comply with the requirement to apply customer due diligence measures
nodes.description: Inability to comply with the requirement to apply customer due diligence measures

nodes.label: Customer
nodes.description: Natural or legal person receiving services.

nodes.label: Refrain from transaction
nodes.description: Obligation to stop carrying out a transaction or establishing a relationship.

nodes.label: Terminate business relationship
nodes.description: Obligation to end an existing business relationship.

nodes.label: Report suspicion to FIU
nodes.description: Obligation to notify the FIU of a suspicious transaction.

nodes.label: Keep record of actions
nodes.description: Obligation to maintain records of CDD actions and decisions.

nodes.label: Record of decisions and supporting documents
nodes.description: Documents evidencing decisions and justifications for CDD.

nodes.label: Apply measures to ensure compliance
nodes.description: Obligation for credit and financial institutions to adopt measures ensuring AML/CFT compliance.

nodes.label: Art. 26 — Ongoing monitoring of the business relationship and monitoring of transactions performed by customers
nodes.description: Ongoing monitoring of the business relationship and monitoring of transactions performed by customers

nodes.label: Conduct ongoing monitoring
nodes.description: Obliged entities must monitor business relationships and transactions continuously.

nodes.label: Issue guidelines on ongoing monitoring
nodes.description: AMLA must publish guidance on ongoing monitoring of relationships and transactions.

nodes.label: 1 year
nodes.description: Maximum update period for higher‑risk customers.

nodes.label: 5 years
nodes.description: Maximum update period for other customers.

nodes.label: Art. 34 — Scope of application of enhanced due diligence measures
nodes.description: Scope of application of enhanced due diligence measures

nodes.label: Trust or company service provider
nodes.description: A trust or company service provider obliged under the AMLR.

nodes.label: Apply enhanced due diligence measures
nodes.description: Obliged entities must apply enhanced due diligence measures.

nodes.label: Obtain additional information on the customer and the beneficial owners
nodes.description: Collect extra data on the customer and its beneficial owners.

nodes.label: Obtain additional information on the intended nature of the business relationship
nodes.description: Collect extra data on the intended nature of the business relationship.

nodes.label: Obtain additional information on the source of funds and source of wealth
nodes.description: Collect extra data on the source of funds and wealth of the customer and beneficial owners.

nodes.label: Obtain information on the reasons for the intended or performed transactions
nodes.description: Collect information on why the transactions are intended or performed.

nodes.label: Obtain approval of senior management for establishing or continuing the business relationship
nodes.description: Secure senior‑management approval for starting or continuing the relationship.

nodes.label: Conduct enhanced monitoring of the business relationship
nodes.description: Increase the number, timing and depth of controls on the relationship.

nodes.label: Require first payment through an account in the customer’s name
nodes.description: Mandate that the first payment be made via an account in the customer’s name.

nodes.label: Apply specific measures for personalised services
nodes.description: Implement procedures to mitigate risks linked to personalised services.

nodes.label: Increased risk of money laundering
nodes.description: A condition indicating a higher risk of money laundering.

nodes.label: Obtain additional information on the source of funds
Art. 39 — Prohibition of correspondent relationships with shell institutions
nodes.description: Prohibition of correspondent relationships with shell institutions

nodes.label: Crypto-asset service provider
nodes.description: A provider of crypto‑asset services that is bound by the AMLR.

nodes.label: Shell institution
nodes.description: An entity whose accounts are used to conceal the origin of funds.

nodes.label: Enter into correspondent relationship
nodes.description: The act of establishing a correspondent relationship with another institution.

nodes.label: Continue correspondent relationship
nodes.description: The act of maintaining an existing correspondent relationship.

nodes.label: Ensure no correspondent relationship with known shell users
nodes.description: Take measures to avoid any correspondent relationship with a party known to serve shell institutions.

nodes.label: Ensure accounts not used by shell institutions
nodes.description: Make sure that the provider’s accounts are not exploited by shell institutions.

nodes.label: Have internal policies to detect attempts
nodes.description: Implement policies, procedures and controls to detect attempts to use accounts for unregulated crypto‑asset services.

nodes.label: Art. 42 — Specific provisions regarding politically exposed persons
nodes.description: Specific provisions regarding politically exposed persons

nodes.label: Obtain senior management approval
nodes.description: Obtain senior management approval for occasional transactions or relationships with PEPs.

nodes.label: Establish source of wealth and source of funds
nodes.description: Take measures to determine source of wealth and funds for PEP transactions.

nodes.label: Conduct enhanced, ongoing monitoring
nodes.description: Perform enhanced ongoing monitoring of PEP business relationships.

nodes.label: Issue guidelines on identification of close associates
nodes.description: Issue guidelines on criteria for identifying close associates of PEPs.

nodes.label: Politically exposed person
nodes.description: Person holding a prominent public function.

nodes.label: Occasional transaction with politically exposed person
nodes.description: An occasional transaction involving a PEP.

nodes.label: Business relationship with politically exposed person
nodes.description: A business relationship with a PEP.

nodes.label: Art. 45 — Measures for persons who cease to be politically exposed persons
nodes.description: Measures for persons who cease to be politically exposed persons

nodes.label: Former politically exposed person
nodes.description: A person who previously held a prominent public function.

nodes.label: Take into account continuing risk
nodes.description: Consider the continuing risk from a former function in risk assessment.

nodes.label: Apply mitigation measures
nodes.description: Apply measures referred to in Article 34(4) to mitigate risks.

nodes.label: Art. 46 — Family members and persons known to be close associates of politically exposed persons
nodes.description: Family members and persons known to be close associates of politically exposed persons

nodes.label: Apply measures from Articles 42,44,45
nodes.description: Apply the measures set out in Articles 42, 44 and 45

nodes.label: Family member or close associate of politically exposed person
nodes.description: Family members or persons known to be close associates of a politically exposed person

nodes.label: Art. 52 — Beneficial ownership through ownership interest
nodes.description: Beneficial ownership through ownership interest

nodes.label: Identify beneficial owners
nodes.description: Obligation to determine the natural persons who ultimately own or control a legal entity.

nodes.label: Commission
nodes.description: The European Commission, which adopts delegated acts on thresholds.

nodes.label: Beneficial owner
nodes.description: A natural person who ultimately owns or controls a legal entity.

nodes.label: Increased risk of money laundering or terrorist financing
nodes.description: A condition where a legal entity is considered high‑risk for money‑laundering or terrorist financing.

nodes.label: 25 % ownership interest
nodes.description: A threshold of at least twenty‑five percent of shares or voting rights.

nodes.label: 15 % ownership interest
nodes.description: A reduced threshold, not exceeding fifteen percent, for high‑risk corporate entities.

nodes.label: Art. 69 — Reporting of suspicions
nodes.description: Reporting of suspicions

nodes.label: Provide information to FIU
nodes.description: Obligation to supply requested information and transaction records.

nodes.label: Reply to FIU within 5 working days
nodes.description: Obligation to respond to FIU requests promptly.

nodes.label: Transmit information to FIU
nodes.description: Obligation for the compliance officer to send information to the FIU.

nodes.label: Retain copy of reports
nodes.description: Obligation to keep a copy of submitted reports.

nodes.label: Suspicion of criminal proceeds
nodes.description: Knowledge or suspicion that funds are proceeds of crime.

nodes.label: FIU request
nodes.description: Request by the FIU for additional information.

nodes.label: 5 working days
nodes.description: Time limit for responding to FIU requests.

nodes.label: Art. 71 — Refraining from carrying out transactions
nodes.description: Refraining from carrying out transactions

nodes.label: Inform FIU
nodes.description: Notify the FIU immediately after carrying out a transaction when refraining is not possible.

nodes.label: Assess risks of proceeding
nodes.description: Evaluate the risks of continuing with a transaction after reporting.

nodes.label: 3 working days
nodes.description: Time limit within which the FIU may issue instructions after a report.

nodes.label: Art. 73 — Prohibition of disclosure
nodes.description: Prohibition of disclosure

nodes.label: Disclose transaction assessment
nodes.description: Prohibited act of informing a customer or third person that transactions are being assessed under AMLR.

nodes.label: Disclose to competent authorities
nodes.description: Allowed disclosure of information to competent authorities performing supervisory functions.

nodes.label: Disclose within group
nodes.description: Allowed disclosure of information between obliged entities of the same group or their subsidiaries.

nodes.label: Third person
nodes.description: Any person other than the customer to whom information might be disclosed.

nodes.label: Group-wide policies and procedures
nodes.description: Internal policies governing information sharing within a group of obliged entities.

nodes.label: Art. 77 — Record retention
nodes.description: Record retention

nodes.label: Retain documents and information
nodes.description: Obliged entity must keep copies of documents and information obtained in CDD and related records.

nodes.label: Copy of documents obtained in CDD
nodes.description: Copy of documents and information obtained during customer due diligence.

nodes.label: Record of assessment
nodes.description: Record of the assessment undertaken pursuant to Article 69(2).

nodes.label: Supporting evidence and transaction records
nodes.description: Original documents or admissible copies evidencing transactions.

nodes.label: Records from information sharing partnerships
nodes.description: Copies of documents and records of information sharing obtained through partnerships.

nodes.label: Ensure documents not redacted
nodes.description: Obliged entity must keep retained documents unredacted.

nodes.label: May replace copies with references
nodes.description: Obliged entity may retain references instead of copies, provided immediate provision to authorities.

nodes.label: Member State
nodes.description: National authority of an EU Member State.

nodes.label: Art. 79 — Anonymous accounts and bearer shares and bearer share warrants
nodes.description: Anonymous accounts and bearer shares and bearer share warrants

nodes.label: Keep anonymous accounts
nodes.description: Prohibition to keep anonymous bank, payment or crypto‑asset accounts.

nodes.label: Identify customer
nodes.description: Obligation to identify the customer.

nodes.label: Accept anonymous prepaid card payments
nodes.description: Prohibition to accept payments with anonymous prepaid cards.

nodes.label: Issue bearer shares
nodes.description: Prohibition to issue bearer shares.

nodes.label: Art. 80 — Limits to large cash payments in exchange for goods or services
nodes.description: Limits to large cash payments in exchange for goods or services

nodes.label: Accept cash payments up to limit
nodes.description: Accept or make cash payments not exceeding the EUR 10 000 threshold

nodes.label: Report cash payments at credit institution premises to FIU
nodes.description: Report cash payments or deposits made at credit institution premises to the FIU

nodes.label: Apply limit to private payments
nodes.description: Apply the EUR 10 000 cash payment limit to payments between natural persons

nodes.label: Adopt lower limits
nodes.description: Member State may set cash‑payment limits lower than the EU threshold

nodes.description: Member State must inform the Commission of any lower national cash‑payment limits

nodes.label: Ensure penalties for breach
nodes.description: Member State must ensure penalties for persons who breach the cash‑payment limit
